name: Raise Your Game Programme
whoFor: Economically inactive residents aged 18 to 24, or aged 50 and over, who want the skills, confidence and knowledge to move towards work.
eligibility: Economically inactive (not working and not looking for work)
Has the right to work in the UK
Has a health condition or disability
gate: Is economically inactive (not working and not looking for work)
Has the right to work in the UK
referralRoutes: Referral or self-referral by emailing help@htafcfoundation.com

projects.name: Raise Your Game Programme
projects.overview: Group sessions mixing classroom learning and physical activity, aiming to engage, educate and inspire participants to move towards being economically active.
projects.duration: 10 weekly two-hour group sessions per cohort
where: Leeds Road Sports Complex, Leeds Road, Huddersfield, HD2 1YY

notes: Status before November 2026: Live - grant-funded project (status not stated in the pathways document)
